Webhook retries were completed and validated: transport and retryable server errors retry up to three attempts, 4xx errors fail immediately, sleep was patched in tests, Ruff passed, and the full suite reached 44 passed. Current uncommitted changes include 2 webhook files with 31 insertions and 4 deletions.
